name: Diogo Lopes de Sequeira
bio: Sequeira seeks a trading foothold in 1509. Once the ships leave and the captives remain ashore, he is no longer a harbour contact.
notes: fact: Sequeira led the 1509 visit and escaped the ambush, leaving men including Araújo behind; sources differ on timing and counts (1511-events.md §§1, 4)
gameplay: Berth and warehouse conversations are invented; his roster membership does not place him in the 1511 fleet (1511-events.md §1)
